messages:
Oliver K: Heads-up — we need to flip the EU feature-default for prefix-cache to SAFE_ON at 16:00 UTC today before the bigger 80% traffic flip tomorrow. Can someone take ownership of the toggle and smoke validation?

Priya N: I can own the toggle. Planning to do it at 16:00 exactly. Will run basic smoke (latency, error-rate, tails) for 15m after. :+1:

Sam R: Thanks Priya. Can you also trigger a quick canary sweep for tenant-eu-1 and tenant-eu-2 at 0.5% before full SAFE_ON? Would prefer a tiny canary first.

Priya N: Yep — plan: 16:00 flip to SAFE_ON globally, but sequence: 16:00 set safe-default flag, 16:01 apply canary for tenant-eu-1/2 at 0.5% for first 5m, then escalate to 100% EU if no regressions.

Jean L: Quick checklist: make sure the rollback flag safe_default=false is ready and the config gate has kill-switch set. Also post the dashboard links in thread so oncall can watch.

Priya N: Rollback command (IAM: infra-flags-admin):

```bash
# set safe default off
curl -X POST $FLAGS_API/flags/prefix-cache -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"value":"off","scope":"eu"}'
```

Matt H: Dashboard links: latency: https://dash.redwood.com/d/latency/eu-prefix-cache , errors: https://dash.redwood.com/d/errors/eu-prefix-cache . I'll bookmark and watch for spikes.

deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle job created by Priya N — job id: toggle-1718790123-01. Notifying watchers: @eng-platform @oncall.

Sam R: Who will run the smoke script? I can run the synthetic tests (qps + tail-latency). Priya, want me to start them at 16:05?

Priya N: Please do. Start at 16:05 and run for 10m. Focus endpoints: /generate, /chat/stream, embedding bulk. Capture p95/p99 and any errors.

Jean L: Add an alert condition: if errors > 0.5% or p99 latency increases > 30% over baseline, trigger rollback. Whoever sees the alert should post here and run the rollback command.

Matt H: I'm on pager for 16:00–17:00 and will escalate to SRE if alerts fire. Also I'll keep a watch on the rollout job in infra dashboard (jobs -> toggle-1718790123-01).

Priya N: Confirming sequence and owners: 16:00 flip (Priya), 16:01 0.5% canary applied (Priya), 16:05 smoke run (Sam), monitor (Matt, Jean). Rollback command posted above.

Sam R: Understood. I'll paste quick smoke script here at 16:03 so Priya can validate.

Priya N: One more: if we see any tenant-specific regressions, we'll freeze rollout and move EU traffic to fallback model variant 'v2-safe' (config set via model-routing). I have the commands ready if needed.

Jean L: Minor ops note — don't forget to set feature-telemetry to full for the 20m window so we capture extra traces.

Priya N: Will do. Adding traces for 20m starting 16:00.

deploy-bot: Job toggle-1718790123-01 executed: SAFE_ON applied to scope=eu at 16:00:05 UTC by Priya N.

Matt H: Saw minor blips at 16:02, but within acceptable range. Sam, how's the smoke run?

Sam R: Smoke finished 16:15. Results: errors 0.08% (baseline 0.05%), p99 +18% (below 30% threshold). No tenant-specific failures. Uploading run logs to https://logs.redwood.com/runs/1718790123-smoke.

Priya N: Good — I'll promote from canary to 100% EU at 16:20. Notifying infra for audit.

Jean L: Promoted. Everyone good to close thread when monitoring window ends at 16:40. If any regressions pop up, re-open here.

Matt H: I'll post a short postmortem if anything odd happens, but looks clean so far. :thumbsup:

Priya N: Thanks all. Closing monitor window at 16:40 unless someone objects.

Sam R: No objections. Nice and smooth.

Jean L: Closing the loop — flag owner Priya, rollback command available, oncall Matt monitoring.

Priya N: Closing now. :white_check_mark:
